design: A Western stone-lizard king: a colossal grey-brown reptile with four heavy limbs that, when it lies down, is a long mountain ridge with centuries of moss growing on its back. Scales like weathered slabs of grey-brown stone, eyes with vertical pupils of earthy gold, the throat plates thinnest of all. Longer than a city gate is wide and, when it rises, taller than the city walls.

phases.name: 百春苔脊，回首之请
phases.prompt: Cold pale dawn at the gate of a stone city. Under the gatehouse lies a long mossy ridge of rock that is in truth the sleeping lizard king, its heavy eyelids shut tight. The whole town has turned to stone figures: some half turned to look back, some with a raised hand calling a name, white doves frozen in mid-air above the roofs, a well rope hung with a stone half-bucket, a river turned to rock halfway down a hill. A thin line of earthy gold leaks from under the mossy eyelid. Palette: silver-blue dawn, grey stone, faint earthy gold.

phases.name: 凝城之瞳，石鳞之王，千像
phases.prompt: A low, close view: the eyelids have opened and one enormous vertical-pupilled gold eye stares straight out of the picture. In a round shield, a still pool and a sword blade held up by tiny soldiers, white frost-like stone creeps from the rim toward the centre of each reflection. The great lizard lifts its head to the sky, and clouds turn to boulders and fall through slate roofs and a cathedral dome. A curved blade is wedged against its pale throat. Palette: cold silver-blue, grey stone, one gold eye.

design: A colossal Western-style snow mammoth king, three times taller than the largest of its herd and higher than a watchtower, shaggy blue-grey hair hanging down to the snow, a winter's snowfall heaped on its back like a mountain ridge. Two long tusks hung with icicles; at each tusk root a house-sized crystal core glowing orange-tinged ice. Small dark eyes that hold nothing at all, neither anger nor pity.

phases.name: 受跪千年者，裂冰之约
phases.prompt: Dusk on the north bank of a frozen river. Behind a snow ridge the mammoth king stands half hidden, only a stretch of tusk and a snow-capped crown of back showing. A black fissure cracks across the shallow ice ford. On the slopes around it kneel rows of riders and horses, each sealed in a coffin of clear ice, the water beneath the ice a dull rust red. One small figure stands alone at the fissure. Palette: silver-blue snow, ice-orange glow at the tusk roots, dim rust under the ice.

phases.name: 负冬者，霜象之王，无春
phases.prompt: Wide, cold dawn. The mammoth king strides down into the ford itself, a new glacier spreading from each footfall and shoving south, the low clouds pressed down against the snow on its back. Its frozen breath settles as white frost over a line of horsemen who are sealed into ice where they stand, while one rider alone stays upright, forced down onto his knees. Its eyes are nearer than ever and still empty. Palette: blue-white ice, grey cloud, pale orange glow.

design: A colossal Western burrowing dragon of the earth, larger than a whole city when it lies down, four limbs and folded bat-like wings, scales clay-brown and limestone grey like layers of bedrock. An entire city with wheat fields and sheep pastures rides on its back. A tower-sized golden core beats in its chest; its eyes are buried beneath the city's foundation stones.

phases.name: 千年城基，云中的掘地龙，覆城
phases.prompt: A black highland sky: a vast island of rock floats in the clouds and on it stands a whole town of houses, wheat fields and a sheep slope, sails rigged along its edge. The rock has rolled over to the east, so houses, flocks and fields slide toward the horizon and townsfolk cling to door frames, tree roots and one another, hanging over a dizzying drop. Beneath the foundation stones a faint heartbeat glow of gold quickens. Palette: silver-blue cloud, brown rock, warm lamp-yellow windows, gold glow.

phases.name: 驮城的龙脊，压平原野之重
phases.prompt: The great earth dragon is no longer buoyed up and sinks with the whole town on its back. Cracks in the foundation reveal dragon scales and one half-open eye, a thousand years of soil sliding off its flanks. Below, on a mountain summit, a giant with arms spread holds the weight up, feet crushing the peak to the knees, streams of gold running down his back. Tiny town lights tilt in the dusk sky. Palette: slate blue, earth brown, molten gold, a few warm windows.

design: A fire-lizard king: a Western dragon-like creature with four limbs and a pair of enormous glowing red bat-like wing membranes that could cover half a city. Scales charcoal black with red veins, the membranes semi-transparent so that fire shows inside the body. Seven burned-through holes pierce its throat like the stops of a flute. Its wingspan is wider than a castle.

phases.name: 秋收夜的摇篮曲，七孔之喉
phases.prompt: Harvest night over a plain. From a black hill in the north a point of fire rises, and the fire lizard sweeps across the plain on its glowing red wings, the seven holes of its throat sounding together as a ring of faint heat in the air. On a castle wall the guards slump with their heads bowed; horses, hounds and a king in a crown all lie asleep. Palette: night blue, glowing ember red, charcoal black, soft gold of lanterns.

phases.name: 安眠与焚城的笛手，火蜥之王，烬笛
phases.prompt: The fire lizard perches above the city gate, wings spread to shelter half the town, the seven-holed throat still sounding while flame pours from its open mouth. Wooden houses fall to ash, stone walls glow but do not melt, and tiny sleeping figures lie unmoving in the streets. Starlight above, the red wing membranes lit from within like lanterns. Palette: deep blue night, orange-red fire, black stone, grey ash flakes.

design: A colossal molten-horned rhinoceros king, taller than a town tower, its hide the black-red of cooled lava in heavy plates, one horn as long as a man and glowing red-hot. An old spear point is buried below its ribs in a wound ringed with endless fire; its eyes are clouded black. Four-legged, massive, a Western war-beast.

phases.name: 旧矛之怒，熔角犀的王种，焦犁
phases.prompt: The rhino charges with its head down, its red-hot horn gouging a man-deep trench of fire across the plain; houses and grass on both sides ignite until the land is a burned black net. Smoke curls from the grass tips for miles, a well steams, the ground glows. A small distant figure stands in its path. Palette: dark night blue, glowing orange fire, charcoal black, dim silver smoke.

phases.name: 同夜落地的宿敌，贯肋的狂角
phases.prompt: It rises out of a burning crater on a black hill, horn aflame, smashing a shield wall to splinters. A lone warrior clings to its horn, riding it down the hill and back up. The old wound under its ribs has split wide and pours black smoke and fire. Its blinded eyes see nobody, only rage. Palette: night blue, white-hot orange, charcoal, grey smoke.

design: A red-scaled ancient Western dragon, a distant descendant of wyverns, with four limbs and vast bat-like wings that turn half the sky red; lying down it is a row of glowing hills. Half of its fire is black and its wounds seep black smoke instead of bleeding. A thin patch of scale under the throat darkens when it rests; the wing membranes are bare of scales. No horned crown on its brow, eyes of clouded molten gold.

phases.name: 伏火的眠山，无冠之龙，焚原
phases.prompt: The dragon coils around a whole city like a range of burning hills, its chin resting on the gatehouse and its tail sweeping half a wall away. One breath of black-hearted fire runs from gate to wall end, stone cracking, an iron gate melting into streams. The soil around is red, a well steams, wheat ears blacken at the tips, tiny defenders kneel in a line on the ramparts. Palette: glowing red, black fire, ash grey, a trace of silver-blue sky.

phases.name: 自冕之焰，无龙应答的僭王，焚原
phases.prompt: It rises into the clouds with a lone rider clinging to its back, a ring of white-black fire burning above its head like a crown with no base. All hearth fires, altar flames and embers below lean toward it like wheat in wind. It dives, smashing a crater big enough to hold a village, twisting its neck to shake the rider off. Palette: red and white-black fire, dark storm cloud, cold silver-blue rim light.

design: A giant salamander king of the black pool: four slender limbs, wet black skin with no scales, longer than a feast hall when it crawls ashore, a mouth wider than the hall door. Its hands are twice a man's length with five fingers like door planks, slick-skinned; gill frills open and close; small eyes that reflect nothing, like pool water.

phases.name: 葬歌者，黑潭的哭婴，夜啼
phases.prompt: Night mist rolls from a black pool toward a great timber feast hall with a roaring hearth; in the mist a hundred baby-like cries rise and the hearth fire sinks lower. The salamander breaks the door bar and crawls into the firelight, dripping black water, its mouth wider than the door. A few small figures with lanterns huddle at the long tables. Palette: night blue, damp black, ember orange, grey mist.

phases.name: 百婴之哭，未被传唱之名，夜啼
phases.prompt: Near dawn inside the hall the creature's wrist is held by a man; it drags toward the door while people haul toward the hearth, benches splintered, the hearth overturned, four great pillars shaking. Its skin has dried to a cracked grey and one arm is stretched longer than its body. The hearth is almost out, a pale light at the door. Palette: ash grey, ember orange, dim silver dawn.

design: The mother salamander of the black pool, larger than her child, longer than a feast hall when lying down. Ink-black skin with pale old scars across her back, eyes like two bottomless wells, a wide mouth with a thin lower jaw; four slick limbs, slow and silent. Enormous and mournful.

phases.name: 不哭的潭母，衔歌之口
phases.prompt: Night. She climbs out of the pool toward the feast hall, longer than the hall itself, and reaches up into the rafters to take down a pinned arm. She makes no sound; the pool water running off her body presses the hall's lamps out one by one. A small old singer with a harp waits at the long table. Palette: deep night blue, ink black, a few dying lamp-gold lights.

phases.name: 歌冢，怀抱断臂的母亲，缄歌
phases.prompt: Inside a dry cave at the pool bottom, an ancient pale blue-white fire burns, lighting her wet black hide. She lies beside it clasping a severed arm to her chest. At the back of the cave an old singer sits holding a harp. She opens her huge mouth toward those descending; a tiny figure braces the thin lower jaw open with bare hands. Palette: pale blue-white firelight, wet black, deep shadow.

design: A colossal Western wind dragon with four limbs and huge bat-like wings, grey-blue scales like low cloud, wing membranes thin and translucent in daylight, wide enough to shade a whole sea of forest; its eyes are larger than a treehouse hollow. It has not landed in hundreds of years.

phases.name: 垂天之翼，林海上的阴天，云脊
phases.prompt: Overcast sky over an endless forest. The dragon coils around the crown of the tallest tree, its wings like two sheets of drifting cloud, the forest floor beneath them in permanent dusk. One beat sends a wall of wind flattening rows of trees, and where the trees hit lamplight they become walls of fire. A tiny climber is stripped from the trunk by a gust. Palette: grey-blue cloud, pale silver, forest green, small warm lamp fires.

phases.name: 无巢之风，碾林的折翼，云脊
phases.prompt: Wounded in the wing, it comes down from the crown and crawls across the forest, the crippled wing dragging, snapped bones jutting through the membrane. A long grey-green scar is crushed through the forest behind it, treetops flattened to nothing. Tiny watchers on a ridge. Palette: grey-blue, ash green, pale bone white.

design: A king of the thunder stags standing as tall as a city wall at the shoulder, white fur with a blue tinge like a forest struck by lightning, enormous antlers wider than half the sky with room for a house between the tines, burnt black with violet veins and crackling with electricity. Four slender but powerful legs.

phases.name: 千夏的雷角，白林之主，千鼓
phases.prompt: The stag walks down from a high peak carrying a whole summer of thunder; the forest it passes is white from tip to root, every leaf gone, thin electric light hanging on its branches. Bolts fall on roofs, field banks and a well. A shield wall of hide shields splits down its centre like cracked ice. Tiny soldiers brace their heads. Palette: white-blue, violet lightning, charcoal sky, cold silver.

phases.name: 擎天的雷树，替众人受雷的鹿王，千鼓
phases.prompt: On the highest peak the stag stands with its antlers like a world tree, the canopy a vast rolling storm cloud with lightning pouring down every branch. The summit is bare, only white sky around it. A small figure grips one tine and grapples with the stag before being flung away. Palette: storm violet, white lightning, grey-blue cloud, bleached bone white.

design: A three-headed beast with a body that could cover a fishing village: a lion head bigger than a city gate with a red mane, a ram head with violet-black curling horns wrapped in lightning, and a deep-green serpent tail that vanishes into the sea. Four heavy limbs. Black ichor in its veins. Fire, lightning and tide breath from its three heads.

phases.name: 三曜之躯，岔口的弃儿，三灾
phases.prompt: White steam over a sea inlet. The three-headed beast crouches in a bank of steam that has not cleared for centuries, lava running into the sea on the west, a lightning column falling on the east. The steam turns red at the lion's mouth, violet at the ram's, sea green at the serpent's. Boat anchors sag in the heated water, white-bellied fish float. Palette: red, violet, sea green, white steam, dark water.

phases.name: 倒长之山，火雷潮的共主
phases.prompt: All three mouths fire straight upward together, flame mixed with lightning, lightning mixed with water, layer upon layer rising like a mountain growing upside down. There are only thin gaps between the layers in the sky. Tiny ships far below. The sea below boils white where it meets the falling streaks. Palette: red, violet, sea green, black cloud.

design: A very old molten-horned rhinoceros that has reached the peak of mortal power. Its back is crusted a foot thick in glaring white salt, the same white as the land beyond the line, only the horn tip glowing faint red underneath. Eyes like two burning coals sunk in salt, hooves buried in salt crust. A heavy Western war-beast, four legs, city-gate tall.

phases.name: 走边的白犀，盐角
phases.prompt: Blinding white salt flat in daylight with a single straight line drawn across it. A white rhino stands on the line casting no shadow, its salt crust cracking where it charges to show the red horn underneath. A mile away stand white carts, white hounds and white deer made of salt, and salt-brick cairns one after another. Palette: glare white, pale blue shadow, one thread of red.

phases.name: 盐封之躯，半熄的熔角
phases.prompt: Wounded: new lumps of salt grow over its body like scabs and nothing can seep out of it, the horn's red reduced to a thin line. It stands braced in the salt flat, a bucket of water splashed over its flank dissolving one patch. Tiny people with buckets stand around it. Palette: white, pale blue-grey, faint ember red.

phases.name: 候神之犀，化盐的朝圣
phases.prompt: The rhino has turned its back and walks into the white light beyond the line, its outline fading into the glow, white all the way. A second salt statue of a rhino stands on the line facing inward. A line of tiny watchers stands behind the line, none crossing it, and the salt wind lifts a veil of white dust. Palette: white-gold glare, pale blue, the faintest red.

block: M12 盐角·隐藏 卤梦
design: An ancient coiled Western serpent as thick as a tree trunk and impossibly long, dark scales crusted with white salt blossoms where brine has dried, small ember eyes. It lives beneath the salt crust of a brine pool. A narrow wedge-shaped head with a heavy brow, belly pale with salt rime.

phases.name: 覆盐的长梦，碧湾的远客
phases.prompt: Beside a green-brined salt pool, workers have smashed the salt crust apart to draw brine, and from the broken water an old coiled serpent rises, brine running down its scales and crystallising into white flowers. Pale salt flats, a cold dawn sky, tiny workers stepping back with picks in their hands. Palette: pale turquoise brine, white salt, dark scales, silver-blue sky.

note: The source body text describes a salt rhino; the look text describes this serpent, so it is drawn as a serpent.

design: A song-whale king: when it surfaces its back is like a reef rising from the sea, half a mile long, blue-grey as rock with a pearl sheen along the fins. A great horn-like air sac at its throat can move the tide. A colossal Western sea beast, no legs, large fins.

phases.name: 七夜潮歌，西海之喉，歌海
phases.prompt: Night in a bay. Far out in the deep water a long reef-like back breaks the surface, and the townsfolk walk slowly down toward the sea with smiles on their faces. The tide climbs the city walls; a ship is lifted out of the water on the whale's back and tipped over. Palette: night blue, pearl white, deep teal, small warm lanterns on the shore.

phases.name: 沉涡的咏叹，明珠的旧主，歌海
phases.prompt: Sunken deep, the whale turns in a vast spiral whirlpool that pulls ships downward in circles. At the centre of the whirlpool a single point of pearl-white light is its open throat. Dark water, a few spinning wrecks. Far above, a ring of pale sky is all that remains of the surface, and a few drowned masts turn slowly in the current. Palette: deep teal, pearl white, black water.

design: An ancient island-whale king: a colossal blue-grey whale whose back rises from the sea like an island with grass, birds and a fire pit. Deep grey skin crusted with barnacles, the soil on its back brown-black and boggy, the grass dark green. Twelve ships can be moored to it. One eye larger than a ship's sail, glowing like a dim yellow lantern when it surfaces.

phases.name: 蜃岸，吞舟之王，雾岛
phases.prompt: Warm sea mist rolls in from miles away, and in it rises an island with grass and birds and a flat place for a campfire. Small ships are tied along its shore and a camp is lit; as the fire takes the island begins to sink and a whirlpool spins in the sea. A yellow eye like a lantern rises out of the mist and looks at what it has swallowed. Palette: pale grey mist, lamp yellow, dark sea, soft grey-blue.

phases.name: 独眼的昏灯，执名的老鲸
phases.prompt: One eye is blind, scarred black where a harpoon struck, the other glows in the mist like a lantern, turning this way and that. A tiny rowing boat is followed through the mist by the great shape. Behind the boat the wake glows faintly, and fishing nets hang torn from its back like seaweed. Palette: grey mist, one yellow lantern eye, dark teal sea.

phases.name: 双盲的漂岛，避名之雾
phases.prompt: Both eyes blind, its back burned bare of grass and wedge-shaped scars across its flanks from being caught between two reefs, rolling blindly in thick mist. The mist parts into two walls around one small boat. Seagulls circle over the burnt bare back, and a low horn sounds somewhere in the fog. Palette: grey mist, dim silver light, dark water.

design: A giant wild boar taller than a city gate, bristles like rows of upright stone stalagmites, tusks like two ploughs, a ridge of soil grown on its back. Hide of grey-white stone plate, two yellowed tusks. Stones float into the air as it passes.

phases.name: 长夜的獠牙，石鬃之王，熄原
phases.prompt: Daytime. The stone-armoured boar tears up a wheat field, turning it upside down so white stones cover the plain, boulders hanging in the air around it. A village miles away: dogs silent, hens on the roofs, lamps going out one by one. Its breath steams in the cold air and its pack waits motionless among the boulders, dozens of amber eyes in the dusk. Palette: grey-white, ash blue, pale earth.

phases.name: 雨蚀的石鬃，最后之火的仇敌，熄原
phases.prompt: In heavy rain the stone armour has softened and a hoof sinks into a river. Harpoons stick in its bristles, nine spears have pinned its legs, a curved blade has cut its hind leg and the wound seeps black smoke. It charges toward a single handful of red embers before an east gate, then stops short at a ring of white light. Palette: rain grey, ember red, white light, dark water.

design: A wolf king taller than a horse, hide of bronze plate where each scale looks like a cast piece, an iron-grey ridge down its spine, paws wider than a man's hand. Eyes dim gold and clear. A four-legged Western dire wolf.

phases.name: 岩头那边的王，铜皮狼王
phases.prompt: Among scattered rocks on a hillside at dusk, bronze sparks fly from the wolf's claws as it walks, visible from far away. Arrows bounce off its hide; it stays behind the rocks while a pack circles a small band of travellers. Stone towers and a bell tower are half swallowed in green, and a chain of watchfires burns along a distant rampart. Palette: bronze, dark rock, spark orange, silver-blue dusk.

phases.name: 铸铜之甲，扑首之牙
phases.prompt: It springs from behind the rocks in daylight, bronze plates gleaming one by one, the iron ridge raised like a spine. A lone unarmed man has caught it round the neck and the two roll across the stones together. Pale flowers bloom along the thickest vines, and the cracked road is split by roots. Palette: bronze, grey rock, pale blue sky, warm dust.

design: A vast creeper that spreads across several cities, vines thicker than a man's waist, dark green mixed with bark brown, roots below ground larger than a forest, pale flowers with a yellow heart. A mass of vines and roots, not an animal; no face.

phases.name: 盖城藤，盘根
phases.prompt: Night. Vines climb a city wall in a single night, cover a street in a month and a whole town in a year, yet the covered town still has lit windows. Cobbles heave, shoots sprout from wall cracks, pale flower pollen drifts, sleeping townsfolk are dragged by vines toward the roots. Palette: dark green, bark brown, pale pollen, lamp yellow.

phases.name: 断根之怨，翻涌的大地，盘根
phases.prompt: Half the creeper has burned; it heaves its roots up so the ground rolls like a sea and walls sink piece by piece. Old tree stumps cut two centuries ago are tangled in the exposed roots. A small fighter climbs along a root with an axe. Palette: scorched green, ember orange, brown earth, night blue.

design: A flame-maned wolf king bigger than a horse, its mane bleached snow-white by the volcano's glare, the fire tucked away in the white fur and bursting out only when it runs. One good eye red-gold, one eye clouded with white film. It leads sixty or seventy flame wolves.

phases.name: 硫火之围，敛焰的白鬃
phases.prompt: White-hot ground around a volcano's heart. A ring of flame spreads inward as the wolf pack ignites sulphur along the ground; the white-maned king lies waiting behind the ring, no flame visible in his fur. Small figures are herded inward. The scorched ground is cracked, and clouds of yellow smoke drift across the hunters' path, their cloaks flapping. Palette: white-hot glare, sulphur yellow, red-orange, charcoal.

phases.name: 照白的狼王，白鬣
phases.prompt: The ring has closed on its prey. The king springs from behind the fire, his mane burst open into white fire, mid-leap toward a leading figure. His body is a streak of white flame in mid-air, and the leading figure raises a round shield, hair blown back. The rim of the fire ring behind him flares higher. Palette: white fire, orange flame, black rock, a trace of cold sky.

phases.name: 护穴的独目，归光的残焰
phases.prompt: Wounded, he retreats toward the volcano's heart into a light whiter than fire; his white flames dim in pulses, the den and cubs behind him. He limps on three strong legs, his flanks rising and falling, the flame in his mane stuttering low. A few young cubs peer from a crack in the rock, and far ahead a vast white glow fills the cavern mouth. Palette: white glare, dim orange, dark rock.

block: M18 白鬣·隐藏 盐贡
design: An old molten-horned rhinoceros standing on a mountain pass, its horn a dull red from age, hide black-grey with salt stains along the horn, a heavy Western war-beast, four legs, tired wise eyes. Salt rime glitters along the base of the horn and the shoulders; its dull red horn glows like banked embers.

phases.name: 岁盐之约，守山的熔角犀
phases.prompt: On a narrow mountain pass an old rhino stands in the pass mouth, waiting while travellers set down sacks of salt in front of it. Misty grey morning, rocky slopes, a rope bridge in the distance. A long line of travellers with mules stack grey sacks neatly at his feet, each one bowing her head, while mist drifts through a high cold valley. Palette: grey-blue, dull red horn, white salt.

phases.name: 背约之怒，熔河为界的追猎
phases.prompt: The rhino charges down the mountain, smashing a mud wall with one rush; salt crusting on its horn crackles and falls in the heat. It chases to the edge of a river of molten rock and stops there. Dust and splinters fly from the broken wall, villagers scatter along the track, and ahead the glowing river cuts the valley in two. Palette: dull red, charcoal, orange glow, grey sky.

note: The source body text describes a wolf; the look text describes this rhino, so it is drawn as the rhino.

design: A thunder-wolf king lying like a low hill, running with half the sky laced by its lightning veins; fur lead-grey with violet streaks, dozens of lightning wolves following it. A giant Western dire wolf, four legs, electric violet marks. Its shoulders are as high as a house.

phases.name: 无声雷，九雷
phases.prompt: A wasteland where the trees are all bleached white; iron tools tingle, hair lifts, a horse refuses to leave a city gate. A single flash on the horizon, the light arriving before any sound, a figure falling. The pack hunts in circles of light across the wasteland. Palette: white-violet, lead grey, pale sky.

phases.name: 剥皮之仇，迟来的雷鸣，九雷
phases.prompt: Wounded, the wolf king gives voice at last and the first thunder falls so loud that listeners go deaf; violet lightning bursts from spine to tail. It charges straight at us instead of hiding. The wolves behind him scatter in terror, the white trees around burst into splinters, and a rim of storm cloud rolls down the hills. Tiny defenders hold up shields and cover their ears. Palette: violet, white, charcoal.

design: A great female river serpent king with silver-white scales and a small spot of blue on her forehead, a length three times that of a salt barge; she surfaces with one eye larger than a child's head, clear and intelligent. A wide Western serpent, no legs.

phases.name: 汐鳞蛇王，吟河的白潮
phases.prompt: A white wall of water pushes up the river into a city, and beneath it the silver-white serpent slams through boat yards and storehouse doors. On a small island a ring of cold white lamps lights her back; her scales burn white under it but she swims on. Palette: white water, silver, cold blue, lamp white.

phases.name: 失子的母潮，还我之声
phases.prompt: Under an east bridge she coils around the stone pier and the bridge slabs fall one by one; she raises her head and calls toward the taken young. The river runs black with churned mud and torn planks, and townsfolk watch silently from the far bank holding lamps that tremble. Palette: silver, stone grey, cold blue.

design: A storm beast: from afar a mass of black cloud pressing down, up close a face in the cloud, four legs, a tail trailing to the ground, a mane full of lightning; eyes two flashing white lights. The face is twisted out of the cloud itself.

phases.name: 高原上的黑天，风暴兽
phases.prompt: On a high plateau the cloud presses down, daytime turned to night, birds on the ground, a wind wall shifting to one side. Lightning falls one after another into a village, and half the cliff-foot village collapses as the storm beast steps down. Palette: black cloud, white lightning, dull silver.

phases.name: 冲天的雷云，高原的风季，风暴兽
phases.prompt: A small figure climbs onto its back; the beast leaps straight into the thunder and rises through it all night, and before dawn dives into the wind wall to shake its rider off. Wagons and tents are rows of tiny shapes at its feet, and wisps of white steam trail from its nostrils as the great head turns slowly toward the horizon. Palette: black cloud, white-violet lightning, grey dawn.

design: A grey hill-sized beast with mottled hide showing traces of many elemental colours, small eyes, a mouth that can swallow a cart with its horses. It looks like a grey mound lying across a road; a Western monstrous shape on four stubby legs.

phases.name: 断路之饥，灰潮
phases.prompt: The beast moves down a road: grass eaten to the root, bare ground, only the iron fittings of wagons left beside the road, beehives emptied overnight, a cut road behind it. It devours carts, men and half a slope. Palette: ash grey, mottled traces of green and orange, pale sky.

phases.name: 饱卧的灰山，守宴之口，灰潮
phases.prompt: Full, it lies still, belly distended, an oily sheen like a cooking pot rim at its mouth. Tiny people feed it from a long table, and the hunger in its eyes dims bite by bite. Its little eyes are half shut, and a trail of broken fence posts and wheel ruts leads back along the road it came. Palette: grey, warm cooking-fire orange, pale light.

design: An ancient Western dragon, neither a dragon king nor a disaster beast, lying like an overturned mountain ridge, its head taller than a watchtower, folded wings covering two miles, blue-gold scales each as big as half a man, two white breaths from its nostrils. Calm clear blue-gold eyes half closed. Four limbs, bat-like wings.

phases.name: 倦卧之脊，王道古龙
phases.prompt: A blue-grey mountain ridge lies across the king's road and the eighth altar-house is pressed under its belly; the road's paving is hot and snow melts to white steam. A line of people charging up have fallen like wheat after one warm breath, with no wound on them. Palette: blue-grey, blue-gold, white steam.

phases.name: 展翼的青金山梁，无人能解的龙语
phases.prompt: It stands and shakes open its wings, the two road camps swallowed in the shadow of its wings, blue-gold scales lifting one by one. It speaks a single unintelligible phrase. A tall fence of dead trees stands behind him and a child's wooden cage lies abandoned in the road. Palette: blue-gold, pale sky, deep shadow.

design: An enormous ice king in the form of winter itself: the seated outline of a Western ice dragon hidden in cloud, crowned with ice crystals, falling snow as its scales, its body made of cloud and glacier-blue light. No true body or lair; the winter is the body.

phases.name: 没有走的冬天，长冬
phases.prompt: Forest edge. Snow is buried to the middle of the trees, spring eyes frozen to white stone, starved deer have gnawed the bark away, trees dying from the heart outward in the third year. Snow wolves wander the woods. A pale cloud sits over everything and does not move. Palette: white, glacier blue, grey bark.

phases.name: 落雪为鳞的云，北来的君王，约库尔
phases.prompt: Above the forest the cloud reveals a seated colossal outline, each falling flake one of its scales, a crown of ice crystals in the cloud. Tiny pine trees below. Tiny watchtowers on the valley rim lean over and slide, and a river is swallowed by the ground beside it. Palette: glacier blue, white, grey cloud.

design: An ember-maned wolf king taller than a horse, the mane's fire tucked inside so it looks dull red, burning open when it runs; it leads a pack of a hundred flame wolves and a dozen ember wolves. Dark red eyes, clear. A Western dire wolf.

phases.name: 坑沿的火圈，烬鬃狼王
phases.prompt: Rings of fire seen first through fog; wolves light the grass as they hunt and the fire rings close in on a camp where horses have bolted. The king waits outside the flames. Fires on the reef fan sideways in the gale and a thin rope bridge flaps between two rocks, with the sea churning white below. Palette: orange-red fire, grey fog, dark ground.

phases.name: 燃雾之鬃，不舍的追迹
phases.prompt: The dull red mane bursts open and the king circles in the fog; the firelight turns the mist orange. It follows a scent toward a town. The great eye of the storm is a circle of black sky, lightning flickering in the wall, and the nest of sticks and bone is just visible on the summit. Palette: orange, grey mist, dark red.

design: A colossal earth dragon, black-brown rocky armour flecked with silver eaten from cities, a back bigger than seven rings of city wall, a head like a collapsed gatehouse, eyes deep within the armour seams. Four limbs, folded stub wings. Silver specks glitter along its back like stars in a dark sky.

phases.name: 黑石的葬钟，塌城者，地鸣
phases.prompt: Dark: the ground heaves as something turns over below; wells sink in a night, dogs bark at the ground, the city above sinks into dust, walls and towers going down together. Stalactites shiver loose, a broken pick and a cart lie on the rails, and the knocking sound is drawn as concentric ripples through the rock. Palette: dark brown, dusty grey, a few dim lamps.

phases.name: 嵌满城银的新山，王矿掘醒之龙，地鸣
phases.prompt: It bursts out of the ground like a new mountain range, the ridge of its back studded with silver from seventeen years of swallowed cities, the ground cracking for miles. Its head thrusts into a valley mouth like a collapsed gatehouse. The walls multiply its image into dozens of silver-white dragons and one tiny miner holds up a lantern and stands frozen in the middle of all of them. Palette: black-brown, silver flecks, pale dusty sky.

design: A huge storm-eagle king, larger than ordinary eagles, grey-blue feathers with wingtips tinged green, golden eyes, a ring of white feathers on its crown like a crown. Not evil. Its wingspan is as wide as a ship's mast is tall, talons like curved iron hooks, a fierce but dignified Western eagle shape.

phases.name: 扑火之风，寻风的飓鹰，白顶
phases.prompt: It dives out of the edge of a storm eye with a flock behind it; the flock fears the cold white light and will not enter the firelight, but it does not. The white crown of feathers streams in the wind above a rocky reef where a few small fires burn. Palette: grey-blue, white, dull gold.

phases.name: 旋墙的白冠，风眼之主
phases.prompt: It flies up the wall of the storm eye and the wall turns with it, spiralling toward a reef; at the top of the reef is the nest. Tiny figures cling to the rocks. Spiral wind clouds tilt around the stone peak, small rafts of nests wedge into rock crevices, and the whole sky seems to turn about the white-crowned bird. Palette: grey-blue, white spiral cloud.

design: An old burrowing dragon, earth-yellow, scales cold white from embedded silver, a huge blunt snout, dull yellow eyes, white teeth. Four limbs, stub wings. Its body is long and low, like a boulder with a tail, scales layered like silvered plate, and it speaks in a deep voice. Bigger than a stable-house, smaller than a hill. Its snout is heavy and blunt with a ridge of dull armour along the brow.

phases.name: 封口底下的锤声，啃银者
phases.prompt: Inside a mine tunnel: the walls glow silver and bear tooth marks wider than a hand; the ceiling drops dust; a deep slow pounding is heard. Tiny miners with lanterns look up. The pounding is drawn as dark ring-shaped shock waves through the wall, and a loose line of miners climb a ladder with their pickaxes. Palette: silver, dark rock, small lamp yellow.

phases.name: 千影的银鳞，镜中之龙
phases.prompt: It bursts out of the silver wall, scales cold white, and the walls reflect it a thousand times so that it is impossible to tell which is the real one. It gleams cold white in every wall, a silver sea of reflections, and its yellow eyes seem to be in a dozen places at once while small fighters swing hammers at empty mirrored shapes. Palette: silver, white, black.

phases.name: 破封之牙，索银之饥
phases.prompt: It turns upward and its teeth bite into a sealed stone wall carved with a ring mark. Dust and rubble fall, a tiny group of defenders retreat up a stair. Cracks run up the stone, the stair behind is narrow and steep, and the defenders hold up lamps and iron bars while the sealed wall shudders. Palette: silver, grey stone, dim lamp light.

block: M28 封口底下的锤声·隐藏 沉锤
design: An old burrowing dragon, earth-yellow, scales cold white from embedded silver, rusted dark where it has been long underground. Four limbs, stub wings. The scales are blackened and rusty, the jaw wide and heavy, the body filling the whole tunnel from wall to wall like a living plug. Wide flat head, dull yellow eyes, tired old sagging skin.

phases.name: 黑锈之鳞，碎卵之报，沉锤
phases.prompt: It fills the whole mine tunnel behind a fleeing miner who carries a broken eggshell; its knocking is twice as heavy as a hammer. Its dark rust-black scales scrape both walls of the mine, and a row of lanterns dwindles behind it into a narrow shaft. Palette: rust black, grey, a single lantern yellow.

block: M29 七曜兽的君王·赤火，伊格纳隆
design: An elemental king of fire: a colossal Western dragon-king with four limbs and great bat-like wings, the sovereign of all fire in the land, shown as a seated silhouette like a statue in a cathedral, wings folded close around it like a mantle, horns rising like a crown, eyes two points of a deeper white. Its form is made of white-gold fire and glowing molten stone.

phases.name: 火山心的白光，不动的坐像
phases.prompt: Night over a chain of dozens of volcanoes in the far south, all glowing at once, rivers of lava threading down to a dark sea. In the crater heart of the largest volcano burns a ball of light whiter than fire; within it the dragon-king sits perfectly motionless. On the crater rim tiny human figures shield their faces; one of them has hair turned white. Palette: white-gold core, molten orange, charcoal rock, night-blue sky full of ash.

phases.name: 燃峰之冠，熔岩的长袍
phases.prompt: It has risen to its feet inside the volcano, taller than the mountain, wings half open, molten lava pouring over its shoulders like a long royal mantle with a trailing hem; the burning peaks flare behind its head like a crown of fire. Dozens of volcanoes erupt together, the lava rivers turn toward it, white columns of steam rise where they meet the sea. Every flame in the land leans toward it. Palette: white-gold, molten orange and red, black rock, white steam.

phases.name: 比火更白的火，伊格纳隆
phases.prompt: The lava mantle has slid off and fallen away. What remains is a single fire so white that its edges cannot be seen, and within it only the faint outline of the same dragon-king seated again, calm and absolute, like a statue made of light. Streaks of orange fire hurled by mages far below are swallowed the moment they touch it and burn white. The crater has turned to glowing glass. Palette: blinding white with a faint gold edge, black glass, dark red embers.

block: M29 七曜兽的君王·橙冰，约库尔
design: An elemental king of ice: a colossal Western dragon-king with four limbs and great bat-like wings, its whole body clear glacier ice in pale blue and white with faint orange light deep inside like a frozen sunset, a crown of long crystal horns, shown seated and still. Frost forms on the air around it. Taller than a glacier ridge when it stands.

phases.name: 透冰的坐影，垂地的极光
phases.prompt: Deep blue night on the northern edge of a snowfield. Beneath the surface of a vast glacier a seated dragon-king shape is visible in transparent ice, seen but never clearly. Aurora curtains hang down to the ground above it, a forest of ice crystals chimes, and tall blue crystal pillars stand on the northern horizon. A few tiny figures with lanterns on the ice edge. Palette: glacier blue, aurora green-violet, white, a faint orange heart.

phases.name: 晶林的长鸣，南推的冰川
phases.prompt: It rises and the glacier splits around it, the crystal forest shaking as one, ice pushing south, snow mammoths and white wolves fleeing before it; it exhales a long white breath that freezes a small column of travellers where they stand. Wings of ice half open, crown of crystal horns catching the aurora. Palette: pale blue, white, aurora green, faint orange.

phases.name: 雪原的寒髓，约库尔
phases.prompt: The glacier has shattered and only a cloud of pure cold remains, condensed into the seated outline of the dragon-king, ice crystals falling slowly from the air all around it onto black rock. Everything near it is rimed white and still. Black rock is rimed in a thin white skin, and a lone frozen banner stands upright in the snow. Palette: pale blue-white, black rock, aurora violet.

block: M29 七曜兽的君王·黄岩，拉皮德恩
design: An elemental king of stone: a colossal Western dragon-king with four limbs and great bat-like wings, body of rough golden-ochre rock with veins of earthy gold, cut stone plates for scales, a crown of jagged rock spires for horns, eyes dull amber. Shown seated, heavy as a mountain, bits of stone drifting around it.

phases.name: 曜冠的山心，浮石之源
phases.prompt: Deep inside a mountain heart: a vast cavern where the dragon-king sits as a rock-shaped silhouette, stones all around lifting slowly off the floor and drifting upward like birds. Gold-ochre seams glow in the walls. A tiny group with torches at the mouth of the cavern. Palette: ochre gold, dark brown rock, dim amber light, silver-blue dust.

phases.name: 悬空的诸峰，岩曜之潮
phases.prompt: It stands and the surrounding mountains lift free of the earth and hang in the air, rope bridges across ravines snapping one by one; it hurls floating peaks downward. Wings half open, a crown of stone spires behind its head. Falling ravines glow ochre where rock meets the sky, and tiny dragons of dust trail behind the thrown peaks. Palette: ochre, grey-blue sky, brown rock, dust.

phases.name: 群山之骨，拉皮德恩
phases.prompt: The mountains have settled and only a single block of earth-gold stone remains, the dragon-king's outline carved into its face, the ground around it trembling with each pulse. Cracks of gold light across the plain. It looks like a huge tablet of gold-veined rock half buried in the plain, and a cracked road runs toward it from the far horizon. Palette: earthy gold, dark stone, pale dust.

block: M29 七曜兽的君王·绿草，缪拉缇恩
design: An elemental king of the forest: a colossal Western dragon-king with four limbs and great leaf-like bat wings, body of living timber and moss, bark-textured green scales, a crown of branching antlers in leaf, flowers growing along its spine, eyes glowing soft green. Shown seated beneath a mountain-sized tree.

phases.name: 长忆之林，成山的古树
phases.prompt: Deep in an ancient primeval forest where one tree has grown as high as a mountain. Beneath it a green-glowing seated figure of a dragon-king, its canopy of leaves forming a crown, birds and roots around it. Fireflies drift among the roots and a narrow elven stair winds around the trunk, with tiny lanterns at its foot. Palette: deep green, moss, soft gold light, dark brown bark.

phases.name: 醒来的原初之森，合围的荆棘
phases.prompt: The whole forest rises: vines like serpents and thorns like spears close in on tiny intruders from all sides, roots pushing up through the ground, the dragon-king standing with its leaf wings spread across the canopy. The ground is roped with roots, moss and thorn, and a few tiny warriors cut at the vines with axes while pale flowers burst open along the dragon's spine. Palette: green, black-green shadow, pale gold.

phases.name: 原初之森的心材，缪拉缇恩
phases.prompt: The forest has withdrawn and only a heartwood trunk glowing green remains, the seated dragon-king's outline woven of branches and leaves, new shoots sprouting from everything near it. Tiny seedlings rise even from the helmets and boots of fallen travellers, drawn as small green marks, and a soft green mist floats upward through the leaves. Palette: glowing green, bark brown, soft white.

block: M29 七曜兽的君王·青风，普罗凯拉
design: An elemental king of wind: a colossal Western dragon-king with four limbs and great translucent bat-like wings, body of pale celadon-blue cloud and feather-like scales half dissolving into gusts, horns like swept-back wind plumes, eyes pale white-blue. Shown seated in the centre of a column of wind.

phases.name: 立湖之风，不竭的风泉
phases.prompt: A high mountain lake, a sky-blue eye of wind in the middle; the water rises in sheets and falls back. Beneath the wind eye a faint seated dragon-king silhouette in the swirling air. Far below the lake, a ring of old stone terraces climbs the shore, and mist lifts off the water in long white veils. Palette: celadon, sky blue, white, silver water.

phases.name: 怒卷的风墙，逆流的飞瀑
phases.prompt: It stands and the plateau winds gather toward the lake, wind walls pressing, a waterfall flowing upward, the cloud sea at its feet; it sweeps tiny climbers from a cliff edge. Ropes and banners streak sideways, a cart tumbles from a switchback road, and the lake itself is stretched into an upward spiral by the wind. Palette: pale blue, white, silver, grey cloud.

phases.name: 风眼之瞳，普罗凯拉
phases.prompt: The wind walls have fallen away and only a visible whirl remains, the seated outline turning slowly within it. A faint translucent dragon shape turns in the heart of the whirl, wings like pale veils, and loose feathers and leaves circle slowly around it in perfect stillness at the centre. Far below, the lake lies flat and silver under a hushed sky. Palette: pale blue, white spiral, soft grey.

block: M29 七曜兽的君王·蓝水，佩拉古斯
design: An elemental king of the sea: a colossal Western dragon-king with four limbs and great bat-like wings with finned crests, body of deep sapphire water with glowing blue scales that flow like tide, crown of coral-like horns, eyes bright aquamarine. Shown seated at the bottom of a bay.

phases.name: 深湾的静水，云中的水柱
phases.prompt: The bottom of a bay: the water is clear enough to see to the floor, several water columns stand from the sea surface up into the clouds, and at the deepest place a seated dragon-king shape sits still. Shoals of silver fish swerve away from the shape, a ring of slow bubbles climbs from its body, and the sand floor is rippled in perfect circles. Palette: sapphire, aquamarine, white foam, deep teal.

phases.name: 亮潮之镜，起身的海湾
phases.prompt: It rises and the whole bay stands with it, glowing tides surging together, tiny ships overturned, wings of water spread. Boats are thrown up the water walls, glowing blue tide runs along the shore like a mirror cracking, and its huge eyes of aquamarine gaze calm and wide. A white haze of spray hangs over the bay mouth. Palette: sapphire blue, glowing white-blue, dark sea.

phases.name: 倒悬之海，佩拉古斯
phases.prompt: The water has drawn back and one column of sea remains, rising from the sea floor to the clouds, the seated outline inside it and the water running upward. Tiny sailors, boats and fish drift upward in the column's stream and the sea floor below is dark and bare, the water going up in a silent spiral. Palette: aquamarine, pale blue, dark deep water.

block: M29 七曜兽的君王·紫雷，富尔古尔
design: An elemental king of thunder: a colossal Western dragon-king with four limbs and great bat-like wings, body of violet-black scale with white lightning veins, crown of jagged horns crackling with electricity, eyes burning white-violet. Shown seated at the foot of a lightning column.

phases.name: 不灭的雷柱，荒原之灯
phases.prompt: The centre of a thunder wasteland: a column of lightning that never stops, the whole land bright as day, trees all white. At the foot of the column a seated dragon-king shape with tiny people far off. The pillar of light is so bright that the whole wasteland casts no shadows, bleached white trees stand around like bones, and a lone iron cart sits abandoned with sparks running over its wheels. Palette: violet, white, charcoal, silver.

phases.name: 万雷之汇，长昼的雷季
phases.prompt: It stands and all the lightning of the sky pours into it, day and night undivided; it hurls the lightning back out. Bolts spiral inward from every side into its horns and chest, it throws them back as fan-shaped white forks, and the ground is a glassy plain of fused sand. A line of small stone towers glows violet along the horizon. Black clouds boil overhead. Palette: violet, white, black cloud.

phases.name: 雷柱之芯，富尔古尔
phases.prompt: The lightning column has shrunk to a white-violet core and the seated outline flickers inside it. The core is a narrow white-violet spindle in a bowl of fused black glass; sparks leap outward and the whole sky around it is a flickering dome. Tiny fallen figures lie a long way off. The air above the glass crackles with thin violet threads and a ring of scorched stumps surrounds the pit. Palette: white-violet, black ground, pale silver.

block: M30 东方军团的环（金冕城之门）
design: A Western imperial army legion of several thousand: ranks of robed mage-soldiers wearing grey-white mantles over mail, about three in ten of them mages, with shield-bearers and cavalry guarding them. Hundreds of mages linked hand to hand form a great ring with silver-white runic marks glowing cold white. A standard-bearer plants the legion's banner at the edge of the ring.

phases.name: 东方军团的术阵，未合之环
phases.prompt: On a plain outside the west wall of a golden-crowned city, hundreds of mage-soldiers stand in a circle, fingertips touching, shields up in front of them and cavalry on both flanks, a single banner planted at the ring's edge. The ring is not yet closed, its runic marks lighting one by one. A commander stands ten paces outside the ring. Palette: cold silver-blue, grey-white mantles, pale white runes, warm city stone.

phases.name: 合拢的骸银之环，白昼之刑
phases.prompt: The ring has closed and blazes up; one wave of cold white light sweeps over the plain and the west wall turns white, and a white stone avenue from the west gate to the crown hall burns. Foot soldiers advance behind the light. Palette: blinding cold white, black shadows, burnt stone.

design: An ancient Western ice dragon with four limbs and bat-like wings, ice-blue scales set with plates of silver glowing in the scales, a back piled with snow of thousands of years like a ridge, so large that one shake causes avalanches. Its bed is silver.

phases.name: 不化的雪岭，月银原的主人，无眠者
phases.prompt: A white plain: the snow does not melt for miles around it, iron freezes to hands, breath falls as ice. The dragon rises from beneath the ice and a mine tunnel collapses along its whole length; one icy breath freezes a valley solid. Tiny miners flee. Palette: ice blue, silver, white, grey sky.

phases.name: 将眠的守银者，同葬的雪原
phases.prompt: Near its end it turns to look back at the middle of the plain where silver beneath the ground has been dug out; as it lies down, the snowfield around it collapses and the hollowed-out parts sink deepest. It wants to sleep on silver and take its attackers with it. Palette: ice blue, silver, dark pit shadow.

block: M32 白祷（七人原的那东西）
design: A distorted miracle given form: a single entity in which three images overlap and show through each other: the outline of a walking statue of a saint, a ball of white-burning light, and a human face. Wherever it passes the grass turns white and the water turns white. Several times taller than a man, slow and silent.

phases.name: 行走的神像，烧白的光，故去的亲人
phases.prompt: A grassy slope at dusk: the grass on the west side is white and the white spreads toward the east, and at its far edge a thing is walking, a statue outline, white fire and a human face overlapping. Rain that falls on it rises back up. Distant tiny watchers on a hill. Palette: bleached white, dusk blue, pale grey.

phases.name: 叫门的祷声，倒流的雨，扭曲的神迹
phases.prompt: Night. Arrows pass through its whiteness leaving black lines; its light turns a shield's rim bright red; the whiteness thinnest on the left. It presses toward an earth bank where tiny defenders stand; at the bank it halts and falls. Beyond the earth bank a few pale tents glow, and the dark sky is crossed by streaks of rain falling upward. Palette: white, black lines, dusk blue, dim red.
